title: 🔥宏观指标维持避险信号
body: 市场处于流动性紧缩期。BMRI 为 78，处于 RISK_OFF 状态，显示宏观环境仍被避险情绪主导。尽管价格企稳于 $63,834，但缺乏增量流动性支持，风险偏好持续受压，突破缺乏宏观动力。中性。全球流动性何时转向？
body_en: The market is in a liquidity tightening period. BMRI sits at 78, in a RISK_OFF state, signaling that the macro environment is still dominated by risk-off sentiment. Although price has stabilized at $63,834, the lack of incremental liquidity support keeps risk appetite suppressed. A breakout lacks macro momentum. Neutral. When will global liquidity pivot?
